description: This file defines a specialized platform class for MySQL 5.7 within the OrangeHRM project. It extends the Doctrine DBAL MySQL57Platform class and overrides the hasNativeJsonType() method to specify that JSON type is not natively supported in this customized platform.

classes.name: MySQL57Platform
classes.description: A custom platform class extending Doctrine's MySQL57Platform to override native JSON support.

methods.name: hasNativeJsonType
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to indicate that native JSON type is not supported in this platform.
